title: Senior Member of Technical Staff - Go/Python Development and Kubernetes
description:

This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error.
   

  

 Your Role
   

  

* Lead and contribute technically on architecture and implementation for WRSD
* Define and align technical strategy with business goals in collaboration with stakeholders
* Technically mentor and develop a team of highly skilled software engineers and testers
* Define and guide adoption of DevOps practices with tools like ArgoCD, Terraform, CI/CD and infrastructure automation
* Offer Technical leadership and guidance on Frontend development using Angular JS and Backend development like Node JS, Python
* Guide the team to break down features into testable epics, stories, and tasks with estimates
* Interface with architects, technologists, product managers, developers, engineering program managers, QA, Test, Engineering Operations, and customer\-facing teams
* Enhance team skills by providing guidance on good software engineering patterns, DevOps, and MLops practices
* Provide architectural oversight for containerized applications using Kubernetes and Docker
* Define and document architecture processes and architectures \& present them to team \& stakeholders
* Contribute to overall Studio Developer Product strategy and handle other duties as assigned by the Director of Studio Developer
* Support team during Production issues by guiding in quick issue resolution and root cause analysis


 Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architecture, design decisions, and deployment processes
   

  

 Your Background

* BSc (or equivalent work experience) in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer / Electrical / Software / Systems / Mechanical Engineering, Operations Research, Applied Math / Physics, or other STEM field
+ Advanced degrees (e.g., MSc, MBA, or PhD) are appreciated, but not required

* Relevant certifications in Cloud, Kubernetes or DevOps
* 3\+ years leading and driving the architecture of R\&D projects that are on\-cloud and/or on\-prem (preferably both) with high availability, scale, and performance criteria.

 Why join us?

 Your Benefits at Aptiv:
   

  

* Hybrid and flexible working hours;
* Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development);
* Life and accident insurance;
* Sodexo cards for food and beverages
* Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events;

 Apply today, and together let’s change tomorrow!
   

  

 Privacy Notice \- Active Candidates: https://www.aptiv.com/privacy\-notice\-active\-candidates
   

  

 Aptiv is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
description:
**Job Description** 
 – Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
 



**Position** 
 : Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
 



**Experience** 
 : 12\+ Years
 



**Role Level:** 
 Architect / Lead SME
 



**Location** 
 : Chennai
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Oracle OCI Exadata Architect with strong hands\-on expertise in designing, administering and supporting enterprise Oracle database environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
 



 The candidate must have strong experience with OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D), Exadata VM Clusters, Oracle Database 19c/23ai, RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, Exadata patching, performance tuning, OCI networking and disaster recovery.
 



 This is a hands\-on Architect/Lead SME role requiring strong technical leadership and the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Architect, administer and support OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D).
 



 • Provision, configure and manage Exadata Infrastructure and Exadata VM Clusters.
 



 • Manage Exadata compute, memory, storage, database servers and storage servers, including capacity planning and resource optimization.
 



 • Plan and execute Exadata Infrastructure, VM Cluster, Grid Infrastructure and Database RU patching, including pre\-checks, validation and rollback planning.
 



 • Administer and troubleshoot Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, SCAN, VIP, listeners and database services.
 



 • Support Oracle Database 19c and 23ai, including patching, upgrades and migration activities.
 



 • Design and support Data Guard / Active Data Guard, RMAN backup/recovery and DR solutions.
 



 • Monitor and troubleshoot Exadata Storage Servers, cell services, flash/cache, I/O and database performance.
 



 • Perform performance analysis and tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor and Exadata performance metrics.
 



 • Perform regular health checks, capacity reviews, proactive monitoring and performance assessments.
 



 • Lead troubleshooting and RCA for critical P1/P2 production incidents and coordinate with Oracle Support for critical SRs.
 



 • Support database and workload migrations from on\-premises or other Oracle platforms to OCI Exadata.
 



 • Work closely with Oracle DBA, EBS Apps DBA, OCI, middleware, network and security teams.
 



**OCI Infrastructure \& Networking** 




 Strong working knowledge of OCI infrastructure supporting Exadata environments, including:
 



 VCN \& Subnets \| Client \& Backup Networks \| NSGs \| Security Lists \| Route Tables \| DRG \| DNS/SCAN \| FastConnect \| Site\-to\-Site VPN \| OCI IAM \| Vault/KMS \| OCI Monitoring \| Alarms \| Object Storage \| TDE
 



 The candidate should be capable of troubleshooting application\-to\-database, RAC, on\-premises\-to\-OCI and network latency/connectivity issues.
 



**Required Technical Skills** 




 OCI Exadata / ExaDB\-D \| Exadata VM Clusters \| Oracle Database 19c \& 23ai \| Oracle RAC \| Grid Infrastructure \| ASM \| Data Guard \| RMAN \| Exadata Patching \| AWR/ASH \| Performance Tuning \| OCI Networking \| Linux \| Backup \& Recovery \| DR \| Database Migration \| Patching \& Upgrades
 



 Experience supporting large enterprise Oracle database environments is required.
 



 Experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite R12\.2 running on OCI Exadata will be an added advantage.
 



**Preferred Certifications** 




 Relevant Oracle certifications are preferred, particularly:
 



 • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
 



 • Oracle Cloud Database Services Professional
 



 • Oracle Database Administration OCP / Professional
 



 • Relevant Oracle Database 23ai certification
 



 • Relevant Oracle Exadata, OCI Networking, Security or Migration certifications
 



**Candidate Profile** 




 The candidate should be a hands\-on OCI Exadata Architect / Lead SME, not limited to architecture or OCI networking.
 



 Strong experience in Exadata administration, VM Cluster management, Exadata patching, RAC/ASM, performance troubleshooting and production operations is essential.
 



 The role requires strong communication, customer\-facing, troubleshooting and documentation skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, production incidents, architecture reviews, migrations, patching and performance optimization in an enterprise managed\-services environment.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC299929
description:
**Description**
**About the Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high\-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI\-led engineering through hands\-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Attributes**
 Experience: 15\+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product\-side delivery.
   

  

 – SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
   

  

 Hands\-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE\-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
   

  

 Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
   

  

 Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability

 Job responsibilities

* Client Engagement \& Strategic Architecture

* Value Measurement \& Executive Alignment


 Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story\-to\-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
   

  

 Technical \& Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long\-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C\-level stakeholders.
   

  

 What we offer

 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:**

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. title: Transformation Lead - AD
description:
**Role:** 
 Transformation Lead
   

  

**Business Vertical:** 
 IOA – Tech
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Hands\-on leader who acts as one of our most senior technical experts in the field. This is a unique, dual\-mission role. Externally, you will engage with our most strategic clients in a "forward\-deployed" capacity, leading technical workshops to design and integrate our data solutions into their complex ecosystems. Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.
* Experience Building Internal Tools: A track record of identifying an internal business need and building a software solution to address it, driving measurable efficiency gains.
* An advanced degree (master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is a strong plus.
* A portfolio of projects (e.g., GitHub) or detailed case studies demonstrating your work in building AI\-driven solutions.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

description:

We create rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!
   

  

 CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices worldwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia.
   

  

 We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a
 **Senior Specialist or Developer II** 
 to join the
 **GDC** 
 team in our
 **SAP** 
 practice.
   

  

 CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings.
   

  

**YOUR TEAM.**

This role involves ensuring system performance, reliability, and security while supporting business operations and strategic initiatives.
   

  

**WHY COHNREZNICK?**
 At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. * Assess the current SDLC end\-to\-end and identify which stages are suitable for agent autonomy, agent\-assist, or remain human\-owned (a maturity/readiness map, not a blanket "automate everything")
* Design and stand up the agentic architecture: agent orchestration layer, tool/permission scoping, approval and escalation gates, integration with existing CI/CD and code review systems
* Define and implement guardrails: security review for agent\-generated code, cost/usage controls, rollback and audit mechanisms, human sign\-off checkpoints for high\-risk changes
* Select and integrate the agent tooling stack (build vs. buy decisions across orchestration frameworks, coding agents, testing agents, deployment agents)
* Run a phased rollout (pilot team → expanded pilot → org\-wide) with clear success metrics at each stage — cycle time, defect rate, agent\-error rate, developer trust/adoption
* Own change management: training engineering teams on new workflows, redefining code\-review and QA roles, working with security/compliance on new risk surfaces
* Report to engineering leadership on ROI, risk, and adoption — with honest calibration of what's actually autonomous vs. assisted


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years software engineering experience, including senior/staff\-level architecture ownership
* Demonstrated production experience with AI agent frameworks and LLM tool\-use patterns
* Deep knowledge of modern SDLC/DevOps tooling and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience leading a cross\-functional technology change initiative (not just a technical build)


**Desirable**
* Experience in a regulated or security\-sensitive environment (agent guardrails matter more there)

* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent\-tool integration standards


**What’s in it for you?**

* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations


**About Us**
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
   

  

 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

title: Ingénieur Sécurité Cloud
description:
Le portfolio de Siemens Digital Industries Software accompagne tous les secteurs industriels (Automobile, Aéronautique, Electronique, Energie, Pharma, Cosmétique, Agroalimentaire, ...) dans leur transformation numérique.
   

  

 Venez faire preuve d’ingéniosité à nos côtés et donner un nouveau sens à votre carrière dans un environnement dynamique, innovant et humain !
   

  

**Votre terrain de jeu:**
 Vous rêvez de concevoir et défendre des architectures cloud robustes ? De travailler sur des applications SaaS protégeant des milliers d’utilisateurs ?
   

  

 Notre portefeuille cloud s'étend rapidement et nous avons besoin d'un expert cloud passionné pour consolider notre posture SaaS, automatiser nos contrôles de sécurité, et devenir le "gardien" de notre infrastructure cloud.
   

  

 Audit et hardening de nos configurations AWS (IAM, networking, storage)
   

  

* Implémenter la gestion des vulnérabilités des containers de bout en bout
* Automatiser la détection des mauvaises configurations cloud (shift\-left)
* Implémenter les bonnes pratiques de sécurité cloud (CIS Benchmarks, AWS Well\-Architected)
* Réduire notre "blast radius" en cas d'incident (data exposure, compromise)
* Mentorer les équipes DevOps/Dev sur les principes du "secure by design \& by default"


 Vos responsabilités :
   

  

* Architecture \& Sécurité AWS (35%)


 Vous concevrez et maintiendrez des architectures cloud sécurisées :
   

  

* Design de VPC \& Networking : VPC architecture, subnets, Security Groups, NACLs, VPC Flow Logs
* Identity \& Access Management (IAM) : Policies granulaires, role\-based access, least privilege, service accounts
* Data Protection : Encryption at rest (KMS, S3 encryption), encryption in transit (TLS), secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault)
* Container Security : ECR scanning, image hardening, runtime security
* S3 Security : Bucket policies, ACLs, public access block, versioning, MFA delete
* Container Vulnerability Management \& ECR Security (30%)


 Vous gérerez les vulnérabilités de bout en bout :
   

  

* Déployer \& maintenir des outils de scan de containers
* Contrôle d’intégrité des images docker
* Maintenir les images à jour
* Trier les vulnérabilités et établir les SLAs de remédiation
* Collaborer avec les équipes pour corriger les vulnérabilités
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) Security (10%)


 Vous sécuriserez nos CloudFormation :
   

  

* Revue de code des changements infrastructure
* Scanner IaC pour détecter les vulnérabilités avant déploiement (Checkov)
* Créer des templates "secure by default"
* Établir les standards de sécurité pour IaC dans toute l'organisation
* Collaboration \& Mentoring (5%)


 Vous guiderez les équipes DevOps/Dev vers "secure by design \& by default" :
   

  

* Revue de code des configurations cloud des équipes
* Sessions de sensibilisation sur les bonnes pratiques de sécurité dans le cloud
* Mentorer les ingénieurs juniors sur la sécurité dans cloud
* Participer à la gestion d’incident de sécurité


**Ce CDI est rattaché à notre site Lyon (69\) est à pouvoir dès que possible**
**Statut : Cadre**
**Les atouts pour réussir :**
* Bonne expérience en sécurité cloud ou infrastructure AWS
* 2\+ ans d'expérience pratique avec AWS (produits core : IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, KMS)
* Historique de 5\+ architectures Cloud sécurisées conçues/auditées en production
* Expérience avec containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) et sécurité des containers
* Anglais courant (communication dans un contexte international)


 Vous hésitez encore à postuler? Sachez qu’une équipe expérimentée sera là pour vous accompagner et partager avec vous tout son savoir, vous donnant ainsi toutes les clés nécessaires à l’atteinte de votre succès. Nous recherchons avant tout un savoir\-être et une personne qui saura s’intégrer dans nos équipes, avec motivation, engouement et envie d'apprendre.
   

  

**Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**
 Intégrer Siemens Digital Industries Software vous permet d'évoluer dans un contexte international et dans un environnement de haute technologie. Vous bénéficiez d’un cadre favorable à votre développement et à votre succès.
   

  

 Chez Siemens, nous nous dépassons constamment pour construire un avenir meilleur. Pour cela, nous avons besoin des esprits les plus innovants et diversifiés en matière de digital pour concevoir la réalité de demain.
   

  

 Nous valorisons la diversité en tant qu’inclusion et collaboration de différentes pensées, origines, expériences et expertises, à tous les niveaux et dimensions de l’organisation. C’est pour cela que Siemens Digital Industries Software recrute et reconnait tous les talents.
   

  

**Rémunération et Avantages**
 La fourchette salariale pour ce poste est de €52\.800 à €89\.700 et ce rôle est éligible pour une compensation incitative. La rémunération réelle offerte est basée sur les compétences professionnelles, l'expérience et la formation/éducation pertinentes du candidat retenu. Siemens offre des avantages de santé et bien\-être aux employés ; vous pouvez accéder aux avantages disponibles dans votre pays via ce lien.
   

  

**Diversité et Inclusion**
 Nous valorisons les chances égales et accueillons les candidatures de tous horizons. Chez Siemens, nous croyons que les personnes ayant une véritable expérience de la différence excelleront en tant que leaders. Cultivons une culture de créativité et d'innovation. Nous veillons à ce que les personnes en situation de handicap bénéficient des aménagements raisonnables pour participer au processus de candidature ou d'entretien, exercer les fonctions essentielles et recevoir les autres avantages et privilèges d'emploi. Veuillez nous contacter pour demander un aménagement.
   

  

**Besoin d’aide pour postuler ?**
 Responsable du recrutement : Nele Craeghs
   

  

**Merci d’adresser votre candidature en Anglais.**

title: Director - Business Intelligence
description:
The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability — owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership and hands\-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner — using AI\-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Core Skills \& Requirements**
 Databricks \& Data Engineering
   

  

* Deep, hands\-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning.
* Expert\-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale.
* Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance — building for reuse and maintainability, not one\-off delivery.
* Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data\-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus.


 AI\-Assisted Data Development
   

  

* Hands\-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling — Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents.
* Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty.


 Media \& Marketing Data Fluency
   

  

*You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means.*
* Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate.
* Understanding of how reach and frequency work — served vs. viewable impressions, de\-duplicated reach, and frequency capping — and the implications for how data must be modeled.
* Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics — pixels, tags, post\-click vs. post\-view, and lookback windows.
* Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes.
* Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data.


 Leadership
   

  

* Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model.
* Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team.
* Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders.


**Preferred / Nice To Have**
* Experience with streaming / near\-real\-time ingestion patterns.
* Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform.
* Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics).
* Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment.
* CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines.


**Qualifications**
* 12\+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director\-level capacity.
* Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production.
* Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Location:**
 DGS India \- Chennai \- Anna Nagar Tyche Towers
   

  

**Brand:**
 Paragon
   

  

**Time Type:**
 Full time
   

  

**Contract Type:**
 Permanent\#DGS

You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

title: OCI Cloud Architect
description:
Job Title: OCI Cloud Architect
 



 Location: Chennai /Hybrid
 



 Experience: 15 \+ Years
 



 Support time: UK Time Zone
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 Job Summary We are seeking an experienced OCI Cloud Architect to manage and support Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments across Development, UAT, and Production, including Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) application environments. The role requires strong expertise in cloud security, application hosting, patching, upgrades, CI/CD pipelines, and the design of highly available and disaster\-resilient architectures.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Own the architecture and day\-to\-day operation of the OCI compartments across production, DR and non\-production tiers (DEV, TST, UAT, QA, SIT).
* Maintain secure, scalable, highly available designs across regions, including VCN design, DRG/FastConnect connectivity, load balancing and public/private access separation.
* Manage Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) application environments on OCI.
* Implement and manage OCI security including IAM, policies, compartments, and access controls.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security and governance standards.
* Host, Migration, operate, and support enterprise applications on OCI, including Oracle EBS.
* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines and automation for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Use Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for OCI provisioning and configuration.
* Design and maintain High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions for OCI and EBS.
* Run vulnerability management and enforce security and governance standards — IAM policies, compartments, identity services, auditing and logging — within the customer's retained identity and security governance model.
* Design and maintain HA and DR, including Data Guard, remote peering and application failover; run DR tests and evidence RTO/RPO attainment.
* Perform DR testing, failover exercises, and ensure RTO/RPO objectives are met.
* Apply shift\-left automation to reduce repeat incidents, and support FinOps review of compute, load balancer and storage consumption.
* Operate within the customer's change management (CAB), incident and problem management processes, respecting tenant ownership and break\-glass controls retained by the customer.
* Experience operating in an ITIL\-aligned managed service with SLA/XLA reporting and multi\-vendor governance.
* Excellent troubleshooting and stakeholder communication; comfortable working within a shift roster.
* OCI Architect Professional and/or Oracle EBS certifications preferred.
* Monitor performance, availability, capacity, and cost across OCI and EBS environments.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, database, and application issues across all environments.
* Monitor performance, availability, capacity and cost; troubleshoot across infrastructure, database and platform layers.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, SOPs and runbooks; participate in service governance and reporting against SLA/XLA measures.
* Collaborate with application, database, DevOps, and security teams.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* Experience: 15 \+ Years
* OCI Architect Professional and/or Oracle EBS certifications preferred.
* OCI Architect and/or Oracle EBS certifications (preferred).



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Deep hands\-on OCI experience — networking, security, governance, compartment and tenancy design, multi\-region architecture.
* Proven experience running Oracle EBS environments at the infrastructure, OS and database layers, in a shared\-responsibility model alongside an application partner.
* Oracle Database 19c on Exadata (Exadata VM clusters / DB Systems), Data Guard, backup and recovery.
* Terraform and CI/CD pipeline delivery; automation\-first operating mindset.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Proven experience managing Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) hosted environments.
* Experience supporting Dev, UAT, and Production environments.
* Strong understanding of OCI networking, Security, and governance.
* Expertise in Oracle EBS administration, patching, cloning, Migration and upgrades.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
* Strong knowledge of High Availability and Disaster Recovery architectures.
* Experience with Oracle Databases (Autonomous, DB Systems, Exadata preferred).
* Strong Linux administration and scripting skills (Bash, Python).
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





  




* OCI Architect Professional and/or Oracle EBS certifications preferred.
* OCI Architect and/or Oracle EBS certifications (preferred).
* Experience operating in an ITIL\-aligned managed service with SLA/XLA reporting and multi\-vendor governance.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job title:** 
 Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Manager, IT Systems Administration
   

  

**Contract:** 
 Permanent, Full\-time
   

  

**Schedule:** 
 Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.
   

  

 While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**
* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends


**Cloud Security**
* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments


**Cloud Networking**
* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures


**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**
* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed


**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**
* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments


**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**
* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records


**Minimum**
**What You’ll Need:**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment across global time zones.


**Your Advantage**
* Cloud certifications — one or more of the following are preferred:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* AZ\-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF9\) or prior VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in a production environment
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with IT service management practices (ITIL) and change management processes

title: AI Infrastructure Architect
description:
**Project Role :** 
 AI Infrastructure Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Architect and build custom Artificial Intelligence (AI) infrastructure/hardware solutions. Optimize AI infrastructure/hardware performance, power consumption, cost and scalability of computational stack. Advise on AI infrastructure technology and vendor evaluation, selection and full stack integration.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Machine Learning (ML)
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Snowflake Data Warehouse, Microsoft Azure Data Services
   

  

**Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

**Role Summary / Description**
 As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end\-to\-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI\-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI\-ready data/feature pipelines, model\-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost\-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake\-based AI infrastructure solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI\-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
   

  

 Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high\-throughput data access design.
   

  

 Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
   

  

 Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade\-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
   

  

 Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
   

  

 Drive architecture decision\-making by documenting rationale, trade\-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
   

  

 Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
   

  

 Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
   

  

 Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
   

  

 Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
   

  

 Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large\-scale engineering solutions.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C\+\+, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
   

  

 Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform\-native workflow tooling.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work in a fast\-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
   

  

 Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large\-scale solutions.
   

  

 Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Strong hands\-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
   

  

 Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model\-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
   

  

 Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
   

  

 Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
   

  

 Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials.
   

  

 Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e\-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where data/AI platforms must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost\-control requirements.
   

  

 Exposure to Snowpark, Cortex/AI features, vector search, retrieval pipelines, feature engineering, model enablement and AI application architecture.
   

  

 Knowledge of Snowflake governance, secure data sharing, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

title: Forward Deployed AI Strategist {Chennai}
description:
**About DevRev**
 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
 *Computer* 
 – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
 *Computer* 
 unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI\-ready platform, giving employees real\-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI\-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human\-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M\+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Forward Deployed AI Strategist** 
 , you will serve as the lead technical strategist embedded with our customers. You'll own the end\-to\-end design of AI\-driven business transformation projects from understanding domain\-specific needs to architecting scalable agent\-based solutions using DevRev’s platform. This role requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture, AI solutioning, customer empathy, and cross\-functional collaboration. You’ll act as the connective tissue between pre\-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams bringing our AI capabilities to life for real\-world impact.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own Customer Context: Deeply understand customer business domains, systems, and OKRs/KPIs to guide solution design.
* Architect AI Transformation: Design and document AI\-driven workflows, agents, skills, and system integrations that align with customer goals and industry best practices.
* Be a Trusted Advisor: Build strong partnerships with customer stakeholders as their technical counterpart, delivering confidence in our platform’s capabilities.
* Translate \& Coordinate: Bridge the gap between pre\-sales/CS and engineering, ensuring requirements are actionable and outcomes measurable.
* Design Reusability: Architect modular, scalable solutions that can be extended across customers and verticals.
* Drive Delivery: Collaborate with Applied AI engineers to oversee solution implementation, ensuring architectural alignment and execution excellence.
* Support Pre\-Sales: Partner with sales engineers and customer teams to scope new opportunities, define technical requirements, and provide input on feasibility and effort.
* Lead Innovation: Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI, software integration, and business transformation—and bring that insight to our solution designs.
* Maintain Quality \& Compliance: Ensure all solutions meet performance, security, and compliance standards.


**What You'll Bring**
* Experience: 7\+ years in solution architecture or consulting roles, focused on enterprise\-scale, customer\-facing software implementations.
* AI \& Cloud: Hands\-on experience with generative AI tools, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and modern integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, pipelines).
* Business Acumen: Strong understanding of customer priorities, with the ability to translate business needs into technical execution plans.
* Design Thinking: A problem\-solver with a growth mindset, skilled in crafting scalable and future\-proof architectures.
* Communication: Exceptional ability to convey complex technical and business concepts to diverse stakeholders, both technical and non\-technical.
* Project Leadership: Proficiency with project planning tools and methodologies; capable of managing multiple solution tracks and timelines.
* Metrics Focus: Proven ability to define and track success through OKRs, KPIs, and tangible business outcomes.
* SaaS \& Platform Fluency: Background in SaaS or enterprise platforms, with understanding of extensibility and multi\-tenant design principles.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus.


**Travel Ready:** 
**Willingness to travel up to 80% for on\-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.**
 As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
   

  

*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

 We are seeking an experienced Software Developer Engineering 4 to serve as the senior technical leader across a diverse portfolio of data engineering, platform engineering, and application development initiatives. They will be responsible for driving architectural excellence, ensuring engineering best practices, mentoring teams, supporting production\-critical systems, and accelerating modernization and AI\-driven initiatives. This is a high\-impact role supporting multiple business\-critical platforms and applications across the organisation.

 Technical Leadership

* Establish and enforce engineering standards, coding guidelines, and best practices.

 Engineering Excellence
   

  

* Improve software quality, delivery velocity, and operational stability.

* Identify and mitigate technical debt, system risks, and operational bottlenecks.
* Champion continuous improvement and engineering productivity initiatives.


 Mentorship \& People Development
   

  

* Mentor Engineering 1, Engineering 2, and Engineering 3 engineers.
* Provide guidance on system design, coding, troubleshooting, and technical career growth.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, learning, and collaboration.
* Build future technical leaders within the organisation.


 Production Support \& Operational Leadership
   

  

* Act as the senior escalation point for critical production incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis and drive long\-term corrective actions.
* Improve system observability, monitoring, resiliency, and reliability practices.

title: Environment Analyst, Associate Vice President
description:
Join us as an Environment Analyst
   

  

* In this key role, you’ll support a set of environments used by a platform’s applications and assist as a point of contact for environment related activities
* We’ll look to you to assist environment managers in preparing a rolling environmental strategy which considers risks in relation to stability and resilience
* You’ll be joining a collaborative and supportive team, and have the opportunity to work with a range of stakeholders across the bank
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 We’re looking for an Environment Analyst to enable the successful implementation of platform change and deliver customer value by assisting environment managers to deliver complex and critical environment related activities. You’ll help create stories and features for the domain backlog to enable a continual progression of changes and look for ways to improve efficiency, resilience, reliability, quality and manual inconsistency by increasing the use of automation and virtualisation.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Also Include**
* Supporting environment managers in managing a set of non\-production environments and maintaining non\-production environment dashboards
* Understanding and maintaining a focus on customer value and providing a positive customer experience
* Continually looking for ways to increase speed, efficiency, quality, resilience and reliability by introducing automated and virtualised environments
* Working with environment managers to understand the upcoming flow of work and the customer vision in order to contribute to a fast response to environment related needs
* Working with a range of stakeholders across the bank and third party suppliers to make sure that platform environments are optimised


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 We’re looking for someone with minimum 8\+ years of IT experience in Environment/ Infrastructure management. You should have extensive experience of networking technologies such as LAN, WAN, load balancing and firewalls, ideally including F5 and Fortinet. You’ll also need experience of using observability tools and techniques with the ability to use data, information, and user sentiment to continuously improve solutions.
   

  

**We’ll Also Expect**
* Hands on and In depth experience in AWS \& PCF. Good Knowledge of GCP and Azure
* Cloud Environment management (private \& public) experience including Kubernetes \& Docker with Unix, Postgres , MongoDB familiarity
* Expertise in AWS Networking (VPC, DX\-connect), AWS EKS, EC2 Autoscaling , ECR, AWS SES, SNS, Lambda , API Gateway , and Karpenter
* Familiarity with deployment and configuration of SpringBoot applications in Cloud
* Experience of DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines and experience of scripting in Python, Terraform, Ansible, Unix Shell and PowerShell
* Experience of tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Splunk, and ServiceNow
* Strong collaborative communication skills for articulating technical concepts clearly to stakeholders

title: Senior Oracle GoldenGate Data Replication Engineer / Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Oracle GoldenGate Data Replication Engineer / Architect to design, implement, and support real\-time and near real\-time data replication and CDC solutions using Oracle GoldenGate Microservices Architecture and Oracle GoldenGate Big Data Adapters.
   

  

 The role will focus on homogeneous and heterogeneous replication across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data platforms, with particular emphasis on Oracle and SQL Server migrations to Snowflake using Oracle GoldenGate Big Data DAA Adapters.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement enterprise\-grade Oracle GoldenGate replication, CDC, and migration architectures.
* Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and administer Oracle GoldenGate Microservices components, including Extract, Replicat, Distribution Service, Receiver Service, Service Manager, trails, checkpoints, and credential stores.
* Configure Oracle GoldenGate Big Data Adapters and DAA connectors for Snowflake, BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data lake integrations.
* Implement initial load, continuous synchronization, and CDC MERGE patterns for migrations into Snowflake.
* Support homogeneous and heterogeneous replication across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud platforms.
* Monitor replication latency, throughput, and availability; troubleshoot capture, delivery, trail, and performance issues.
* Prepare architecture diagrams, technical designs, deployment standards, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Support migration planning, cutover, rollback, incident resolution, and production support activities.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on Oracle GoldenGate implementation, administration, and production support experience.
* Strong expertise in Oracle GoldenGate 19c, 21c, and 23ai, including Microservices Architecture, Integrated Extract, Classic Extract, Integrated Replicat, Parallel Replicat, Coordinated Replicat, and Big Data Adapters.
* Experience with Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data platforms.
* Strong understanding of CDC, heterogeneous replication, data migration, high availability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Snowflake ingestion patterns including stage\-based loading, continuous replication, and MERGE\-based CDC processing.
* Good knowledge of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, data lake, and Lakehouse architecture concepts.
* Strong Linux/Unix administration, shell scripting, SQL, Python, and automation skills.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 A senior data integration specialist capable of leading enterprise CDC and migration initiatives using Oracle GoldenGate Microservices Architecture and Big Data DAA Connectors, with a strong focus on secure, scalable, high\-availability replication into Snowflake and other modern analytics platforms.

description:
**Data Architect – Data Platform Delivery \& Client Program Lead** 




  





**Full Time \| Chennai \|** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to own the architecture, delivery, and client relationship for a strategic data program at an enterprise manufacturing organization, built on a modern cloud data stack. You will operate within the client's established enterprise architecture design standards and governance frameworks adapting and delivering to those standards rather than building in a greenfield. In areas where standards do not exist, you will have the opportunity to shape \& help establish standards.
 



  





 This is a role that goes well beyond technical design. Alongside architecting and leading hands\-on implementation, you will play an account leadership role, own client delivery and stakeholder relationships, contribute to presales, and act as the primary liaison for the data program. Over time, we see your contribution in organizational presales and contributions to multiple accounts.
 



 You will architect and guide solutions across Snowflake, cloud ETL / integration tooling (Informatica IICS, Talend, Boomi), AWS, and enterprise reporting (Cognos, Power BI) while playing a strategic role leading the team and partnering directly with client stakeholders to shape the roadmap and deliver outcomes.
 



 This role suits someone who is technically deep, delivery lead capable, and client\-facing, with solid team\-management foundations and a genuine appetite to grow as a leader. We will actively support your development in people and delivery management.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Architecture \& Solution Design** 




 · Own the end\-to\-end data architecture across the client stack: Snowflake, IICS, Talend, Boomi,
 



 AWS, Cognos, and Power BI.
 



 · Design scalable, secure, and cost\-effective solutions spanning ingestion, integration, data
 



 warehousing, modelling, and reporting.
 



 · Work within the client's enterprise architecture design standards, integration patterns, and
 



 governance frameworks \- and contribute to strengthening them where appropriate.
 



 · Architect Snowflake solutions directly, or partner with the client's Snowflake leads to shape
 



 them, while safeguarding governance: cost management, consumption oversight, warehouse.
 



 sizing, and access\-management best practices.
 



 · Lead technical implementation and stay hands\-on where it matters \- reviewing designs,
 



 unblocking the team, and building critical components.
 



 · Own solution design decisions and their trade\-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical
 



 and business audiences.
 



**Delivery \& Team Leadership** 




 · Lead and coordinate a data team of seven across engineering, integration, and BI.
 



 · Plan and run sprints, manage and prioritize the backlog, and keep delivery on track (light
 



 scrum\-master responsibilities).
 



 · Own solution delivery from analysis through build, testing, deployment, and support.
 



 · Manage defects, enhancements, and a prioritized improvement roadmap.
 



 · Mentor team members, set technical direction, and support the team's growth.
 



  





**Client \& Stakeholder Engagement** 




 · Own the client relationship and act as the primary liaison for the data program.
 



 · Manage stakeholder communications across internal and external teams.
 



 · Gather requirements directly from business and technical stakeholders; define priorities, KPIs,
 



 and acceptance criteria.
 



 · Own client delivery outcomes and contribute to presales relationships.
 



 · Build solution and proposal decks and present them to executive, business, and technical
 



 audiences.
 



  





**Required Skills and Experience** 




 · 5\+ years in data engineering, data integration, or business intelligence, with 1\+ years in a data
 



 architecture capacity.
 



 · Strong Snowflake experience \- able to architect solutions independently or collaborate closely
 



 with dedicated Snowflake leads to shape them.
 



 · Solid grasp of Snowflake governance concepts: cost management, consumption / credit
 



 oversight, warehouse sizing, and access\-management best practices (RBAC, data security).
 



 · Comfortable working within, and delivering to, an established enterprise architecture and
 



 governance framework.
 



 · Strong hands\-on experience with cloud ETL / data integration tooling \- one or more of
 



 Informatica IICS, Talend, or Boomi \- and the ability to design across a mixed toolset.
 



 · Solid experience with AWS data and platform services.
 



 · Experience delivering enterprise reporting and analytics with Cognos and/or Power BI.
 



 · Strong SQL and data modelling skills (dimensional and analytical modelling).
 



 · Demonstrated ability to lead delivery and coordinate a team, with foundational team\-
 



 management experience and a clear interest in growing as a people / delivery leader.
 



 · Proven ability to own client relationships and gather requirements directly from business
 



 stakeholders.
 



 · Experience running agile delivery \- sprint planning, backlog management, and prioritization.
 



 · Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical concepts clearly to both business and
 



 technical audiences.
 



 · Strong problem\-solving, prioritization, and ownership skills.
 



  





**Preferred Skills:** 




 · Experience owning presales and building solution proposal decks.
 



 · Snowflake advanced features and warehouse / cost optimization.
 



 · Experience across multiple ETL / integration tools in the same landscape (IICS \+ Talend \+
 



 Boomi).

 · Experience delivering into a large, standards\-driven enterprise \- ideally in manufacturing or a
 



 comparable industrial / operational domain.

 · Certified Scrum Master or equivalent agile / delivery experience.
 



  





**Certifications (one or more preferred \- not all required)**
